name: Band Step-Up
steps: Face a sturdy box, plant your working foot on top over a resistance band, and hold the ends at your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your chest upright over your front foot.
Drive firmly through your raised foot to stand all the way up on the box against the band.
Step slowly back down under control, then switch legs after finishing one side.
tips: Keep the box steady and minimize pushing off your trailing foot on the floor.
Track your working knee straight over your toes without letting it cave inward.
